import html # Predefined string template for blog posts. # It should contain placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` for the heading and content respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a user‑submitted blog post for safe display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post, ready to be inserted into a webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either `heading` or `content` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise ValueError("Both heading and content must be strings.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS or injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the sanitized values into the predefined template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_content) return formatted_post
